items.question: What can I do with VeriCommerce AI?
items.answer: Import a permitted JSON catalog, retrieve current source passages, create evidence-backed drafts, review and approve them, and export approved content. The evidence engine records work on the server; the collection workspace stores its approval choices in this browser.

items.question: What makes the platform evidence-led?
items.answer: Product claims connect to a named source, passage and revision. The current backend preserves this lineage and marks dependent drafts stale when their supporting sources change. Retrieved quotations still require human judgment about relevance and completeness.

items.question: Will this work with Shopify?
items.answer: Shopify is the first planned merchant integration. Read-only catalog synchronization, approved publishing, verification and conflict-aware rollback have explicit implementation gates in the roadmap. No Shopify store is connected in the current release.

items.question: What is running in the research layer?
items.answer: The evidence engine supports a pinned local CPU embedding model and keyword retrieval. Ten curated regression questions provide repeatable checks. Fine-tuning, larger independent benchmarks and agent-training experiments remain planned work.
